Teemo.name: Teemo
Teemo.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19 (site label 16.19), Jax top vs Teemo top, 829 games; counterstats all ranks ~47%
Teemo.summary: Teemo wins the early lane with Blinding Dart poke and kiting. You win once you have Trinity Force, magic resist and Oracle Lens. Survive, farm, and all-in only while Blinding Dart is on cooldown.
Teemo.runes: Grasp of the Undying with Second Wind in Resolve. Secondary Inspiration (Magical Footwear, Cosmic Insight).
Teemo.summoners: Flash + Ignite (kill pressure through Move Quick), or Flash + Exhaust
Teemo.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (Doran's Helm also works)
Teemo.buildNotes: Mercury's Treads over Plated Steelcaps. Wit's End is a strong 2nd item. Swap to Oracle Lens on your first back after he hits 6. Keep a Control Ward in the lane bush.
Teemo.skillNotes: Take E (Counter Strike) at level 1. It dodges his autos, which carry Toxic Shot. Level 2 Q, level 3 W, then max W.

lvl1_3: Don't walk into the bush he's camouflaged in. Last hit with W (Empower) so you don't get poked while autoing.
Trade only when Blinding Dart is on cooldown. A blinded Jax loses every trade.
lvl4_5: Leap Strike onto a minion or ward next to him, then activate Counter Strike before you land so the stun goes off on arrival.
Ignite as soon as you land. Move Quick lets him outrun you, so commit only if the stun lands.
post6: Buy Oracle Lens and sweep shrooms on your path back to lane and in the river.
Grandmaster-at-Arms plus Leap Strike lets you burst him even after a Blinding Dart.
midgame: Split push with Oracle Lens. With 2 items he can't 1v1 you.
Sweep shrooms before Dragon and Void Grubs so your team can walk in.
lategame: Dive him or the ADC in fights. He dies to one full rotation.
Don't face-check bushes without a sweep.

threats: Blinding Dart (Q): your autos and W miss while blinded
Noxious Trap (R, from 6): slow plus damage over time, so sweep them
killWindows: Right after he uses Blinding Dart on the wave
Level 2-3 if he walks up without Q
Level 6+ with Ignite once Move Quick is down
avoid: Fighting in his bush without vision

Quinn.name: Quinn
Quinn.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Quinn top, 251 games; counterstats all ranks ~46%
Quinn.summary: This is one of your worst lanes. Quinn out-ranges you, blinds you, and Vault resets your engage. Play for farm and scaling, never chase, and make her come to you.
Quinn.runes: Grasp of the Undying with Second Wind. Press the Attack is the other common pick.
Quinn.summoners: Flash + Teleport (farm lane), or Flash + Ignite if your jungler plays top side
Quinn.buildNotes: Rush Plated Steelcaps, then Trinity Force. Sterak's Gage and Randuin's Omen blunt her burst and crits. Zhonya's Hourglass had high win rates in small samples here.
Quinn.skillNotes: Take E at level 1. Counter Strike dodges her autos and Harrier procs. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Farm at max range and let the wave push to you.
If she walks into melee range to auto, press Counter Strike and step toward her so the stun lands.
lvl4_5: Engage with Leap Strike only after she has used Vault.
Hold a freeze near your tower so she has to overextend for CS, then call your jungler.
post6: She roams with Behind Enemy Lines. Ping it and shove the wave into her tower.
Grandmaster-at-Arms' armor lets you win an all-in if Leap Strike + Counter Strike both land.
midgame: With Trinity Force + Plated Steelcaps you out-duel her. Fight near your jungler.
Ward your flanks. She picks off lone split pushers.
lategame: You scale better. Look for picks with your team's CC.
In fights, wait for Vault before you jump.

threats: Blinding Assault (Q): blind plus Harrier mark
Vault (E): knockback plus slow that cancels your engage
Behind Enemy Lines (R): fast roams and returns
killWindows: Vault on cooldown while she's near your minions
Right after she misses Blinding Assault
avoid: Opening with Leap Strike while Vault is up
Leaving the wave in mid-lane where she can poke freely

Singed.name: Singed
Singed.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Singed top, 699 games; counterstats all ranks ~43%
Singed.summary: This is your lowest-win-rate matchup. Singed proxies and kites with Poison Trail, and you can't catch him. Don't chase. Farm, take plates while he proxies, and outvalue him in side lanes.
Singed.summoners: Flash + Exhaust (shuts down Insanity Potion), or Flash + Teleport
Singed.buildNotes: Lolalytics shows Blade of The Ruined King (slow, %HP damage) into Trinity Force. Take Mercury's Treads or Boots of Swiftness. Zhonya's Hourglass later.
Singed.skillNotes: Max W for waveclear, then Q. Take E by level 3.

lvl1_3: Last hit and never follow him into Poison Trail.
If he proxies behind your tower, stay and farm the tower wave. Chase only with your jungler.
lvl4_5: Hold Leap Strike until he has used Fling, or he flips you back into Mega Adhesive.
When he proxies, shove your wave into his tower for plates.
post6: Insanity Potion gives him speed, tenacity and sustain. Walk away or Exhaust him.
Tell your team he'll roam, and keep your lane pushed.
midgame: Split push on the opposite side from him. Don't waste time dueling.
In fights, go past him to his carries.
lategame: You scale harder. Dive the backline and ignore Singed.
Ward flanks so he can't proxy freely.

threats: Mega Adhesive (W): grounds you so you can't Leap Strike or Flash
Fling (E): flips you into poison or his team
Insanity Potion (R): speed, tenacity and sustain
killWindows: He uses Fling and Mega Adhesive and has no escape left
He gets caught proxying near your tower
Jungle gank while he's in your lane
avoid: Leaving your wave to follow him

Vladimir.name: Vladimir
Vladimir.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Vladimir top, 587 games; counterstats all ranks ~49%
Vladimir.summary: You're much stronger at levels 1-5, and Vladimir outscales you. Punish him early, deny farm, and bait Sanguine Pool before you stun.
Vladimir.runes: Grasp of the Undying, or Press the Attack for early all-ins
Vladimir.buildNotes: Buy Chempunk Chainsword for anti-heal. Mercury's Treads. Then Wit's End, Kaenic Rookern, or Maw of Malmortius against his burst. Zhonya's Hourglass and Death's Dance show high win rates here.
Vladimir.skillNotes: Take E first. Max W, then Q. Save Counter Strike's stun for when Sanguine Pool ends.

lvl1_3: Walk up and trade hard. He can't match your autos early.
Bait out Transfusion, then all-in.
lvl4_5: When he uses Sanguine Pool, wait at its edge and Ignite as it ends so he can't heal back.
Stand in his wave to deny last hits.
post6: Hemoplague makes all-ins risky. Engage right after he uses R or Sanguine Pool.
Chempunk Chainsword keeps him from outhealing you.
midgame: Split push. He can't stop you 1v1 until later.
Get anti-heal and magic resist before you fight him again.
lategame: He's a teamfight threat. Dive him fast, and use Zhonya's Hourglass against Hemoplague.
Hold Counter Strike's stun for when he exits Sanguine Pool.

threats: Sanguine Pool (W): untargetable, dodges your Counter Strike stun
Tides of Blood (E): AoE slow and burst
killWindows: Right after Sanguine Pool is used
avoid: Stunning with Counter Strike while he can still Pool

Kennen.name: Kennen
Kennen.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Kennen top, 661 games; counterstats all ranks ~43%
Kennen.summary: Kennen pokes you out with Thundering Shuriken and escapes with Lightning Rush. You win once you have magic resist and he has wasted Lightning Rush.
Kennen.runes: Grasp of the Undying with Second Wind
Kennen.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (or Doran's Helm)
Kennen.buildNotes: Rush Mercury's Treads. Wit's End and Kaenic Rookern are great here. Stridebreaker and Sterak's Gage show high win rates in this matchup.
Kennen.skillNotes: Take E first. Counter Strike dodges his autos and reduces AoE damage. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Farm behind minions to block Thundering Shuriken.
Trade only when he's close.
lvl4_5: Watch Lightning Rush. When it's on cooldown, jump him with Leap Strike.
Don't let him stack Mark of the Storm to 3, which stuns you.
post6: Slicing Maelstrom is dangerous in teamfights. Exhaust him when he uses R.
Counter Strike reduces his AoE damage.
midgame: Split push. With 2 items and Mercury's Treads he can't duel you.
Ward your flanks. He roams and flanks.
lategame: Dive him in fights, and turn on Counter Strike when he casts Slicing Maelstrom.
Save Exhaust for his all-in.

threats: Mark of the Storm: stun at 3 stacks
Slicing Maelstrom (R): AoE stun and damage
killWindows: When he's out of energy in lane
avoid: Getting stacked to 3 Marks of the Storm
Chasing him while Lightning Rush is up

Gangplank.name: Gangplank
Gangplank.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Gangplank top, 1,441 games; counterstats all ranks ~45%
Gangplank.summary: Gangplank pokes you with Parrrley and barrels and outscales you late. Pressure him early. Remove Scurvy cleanses your Counter Strike stun.
Gangplank.runes: Grasp of the Undying, or Press the Attack (most picked here)
Gangplank.summoners: Flash + Ignite (cuts Remove Scurvy healing), or Flash + Teleport
Gangplank.start: Doran's Bow + 2 Health Potion (Doran's Shield against heavy poke)
Gangplank.buildNotes: Plated Steelcaps, then Trinity Force. Zhonya's Hourglass and Death's Dance show high win rates here.
Gangplank.skillNotes: Take E first. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Walk up and trade. He's weak before barrels are set up.
Never stand next to a barrel.
lvl4_5: Engage after he uses Remove Scurvy, so your stun can't be cleansed.
Jump him with Leap Strike when he has no barrels out.
post6: Cannon Barrage is global. Ping when he uses it.
Keep pressure on him so he can't farm freely.
midgame: Split push. He can't match you 1v1 until 3 items.
Take plates when he uses R elsewhere.
lategame: He's a teamfight threat with barrels. Flank and dive him.
Turn on Counter Strike when he detonates a barrel chain.

threats: Powder Keg (E): barrel chains deal big AoE damage
avoid: Stunning while Remove Scurvy is up

Cassiopeia.name: Cassiopeia
Cassiopeia.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Cassiopeia top, 129 games (small sample)
Cassiopeia.summary: Cassiopeia out-damages you with poison, and Miasma grounds you. Petrifying Gaze stuns you if you face her. Play safe until you have magic resist and Zhonya's Hourglass.
Cassiopeia.runes: Grasp of the Undying with Second Wind
Cassiopeia.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (or Doran's Helm)
Cassiopeia.buildNotes: Mercury's Treads. Kaenic Rookern, Wit's End, or Maw of Malmortius against her damage. Zhonya's Hourglass is useful here.
Cassiopeia.skillNotes: Take E first. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Stay out of Noxious Blast range and last hit carefully.
Never walk into Miasma.
lvl4_5: Leap Strike onto her only after she has cast Miasma, so you can't be grounded.
Face away from her when she casts Petrifying Gaze.
post6: Petrifying Gaze stuns you only if you're facing her. Turn around and you just take the slow.
Engage after she has used R.
midgame: Split push once you have magic resist items.
Ward your flanks.
lategame: Dive her with Zhonya's Hourglass ready.
Hold Counter Strike's stun until she has used Petrifying Gaze.

threats: Miasma (W): grounds you so you can't Leap Strike or Flash
Petrifying Gaze (R): stun if you face her
avoid: Leap Strike while Miasma is up
Facing her when she casts Petrifying Gaze

Akali.name: Akali
Akali.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Akali top, 991 games; counterstats all ranks ~43%
Akali.summary: Even lane. You win extended trades before 6 once she's low on energy, and she spikes at 6 with Perfect Execution. Counter Strike's AoE stun still hits her inside Twilight Shroud.
Akali.runes: Grasp of the Undying with Second Wind
Akali.buildNotes: Mercury's Treads. Maw of Malmortius or Zhonya's Hourglass as your 3rd item stops her burst. Wit's End if she's ahead.
Akali.skillNotes: Take E first. Counter Strike dodges her Assassin's Mark empowered auto. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: She pokes with Five Point Strike and backs off. Walk up when her energy bar is low after 2 Qs, then W-reset auto trade.
When she drops Twilight Shroud, turn on Counter Strike and walk to the center of the shroud. The stun hits her even though she's invisible.
lvl4_5: If Shuriken Flip hits you, hold Counter Strike for the recast. She dashes to you, and you stun her on arrival.
Track Shuriken Flip's cooldown. Without it she has no gap closer, so Leap Strike onto her.
post6: Perfect Execution's 2nd cast deals more damage the lower your HP. Back off before you drop below half HP.
After both R casts are used, she's out of escapes. All-in with Grandmaster-at-Arms.
midgame: She roams mid at 6. Ping and push your wave.
Buy magic resist before you duel her again.
lategame: In teamfights, dive her after she commits. Zhonya's Hourglass cancels Perfect Execution.
Save Counter Strike for Twilight Shroud.

threats: Shuriken Flip (E): long-range engage and escape
Perfect Execution (R): execute burst and escape
killWindows: Levels 1-5 when she's low on energy
Right after both Perfect Execution casts
avoid: Chasing her into Twilight Shroud without Counter Strike ready
Trading at low HP after she hits 6

Aurora.name: Aurora
Aurora.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Aurora top, 156 games (small sample)
Aurora.summary: Aurora pokes with Twofold Hex and escapes with Across the Veil. Between Worlds traps you in her zone. Play for magic resist and scaling, and commit only when her escape is down.
Aurora.runes: Grasp of the Undying with Second Wind
Aurora.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (or Doran's Helm)
Aurora.buildNotes: Mercury's Treads. Wit's End and Kaenic Rookern against her damage. Maw of Malmortius if she's ahead.
Aurora.skillNotes: Take E first. Counter Strike dodges her autos, which stack Spirit Abjuration. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Farm behind your minions and sidestep Twofold Hex. Getting hit by both casts is her main trade.
Don't chase her. She kites with autos and moves faster than you.
lvl4_5: After she uses Across the Veil (long cooldown early), Leap Strike onto a minion next to her.
The Weirding knocks you away. Hold Leap Strike to get back to her.
post6: Between Worlds creates a zone that pulls you back when you try to leave. Don't fight inside it at low HP.
Engage when R and Across the Veil are both down.
midgame: Split push once you have magic resist. She can't hold a side lane against you.
Ward flanks. She roams well.
lategame: Dive her when a teammate has CC on her. She has no answer to Leap Strike + Counter Strike when her W is down.
Exhaust her when she casts Between Worlds.

threats: Twofold Hex (Q): poke with a recast
Across the Veil (W): hop plus invisibility
avoid: Chasing her while Across the Veil is up

Gnar.name: Gnar
Gnar.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Gnar top, 792 games; counterstats all ranks ~52%
Gnar.summary: Even lane that you slightly favor. Kill Mini Gnar when his rage is low. Mega Gnar can lock you down, especially near walls.
Gnar.skillNotes: Take E first. Counter Strike dodges Mini Gnar's autos, which stack Hyper. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Trade against Mini Gnar when his rage bar is low. He can't turn Mega mid-fight.
When his rage bar is nearly full, back off. He'll transform soon.
lvl4_5: After he uses Hop, Leap Strike onto him.
Right after Mega Gnar turns back into Mini, his rage can't build for a few seconds. All-in then.
post6: GNAR! stuns you if you hit a wall. Fight in the middle of the lane, away from walls.
Turn on Counter Strike to reduce Mega Gnar's AoE damage.
midgame: With 2 items you out-duel him. Split push.
Ward your flanks.
lategame: Engage after he uses GNAR!.
Save Counter Strike for Mega Gnar's AoE.

threats: Mega Gnar: transformation with AoE CC
killWindows: Right after he turns back into Mini
avoid: Fighting near walls against Mega Gnar
Engaging when his rage bar is full

Heimerdinger.name: Heimerdinger
Heimerdinger.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Heimerdinger top, 300 games; counterstats all ranks ~46%
Heimerdinger.summary: Heimerdinger zones you with turrets and stuns you with CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade. Fight away from his turret nest, and freeze so he has to set up turrets near your tower.
Heimerdinger.runes: Grasp of the Undying with Second Wind
Heimerdinger.start: Doran's Shield + Health Potion (or Doran's Helm)
Heimerdinger.buildNotes: Mercury's Treads. Kaenic Rookern and Wit's End against his damage.
Heimerdinger.skillNotes: Take E first. Counter Strike reduces his AoE damage. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Don't fight inside his turret nest. His turrets shoot you when you hit him.
Freeze the wave near your tower. He has to walk up to place turrets.
lvl4_5: When he misses CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, Leap Strike onto him.
Kill his turrets with autos when he's away from them.
post6: UPGRADE!!! empowers one ability. Engage after he has used R.
Turn on Counter Strike against his upgraded AoE.
midgame: Split push. He can't duel you.
Ward your flanks.
lategame: Dive him when a teammate has CC on him.
Save Counter Strike for his burst.

killWindows: After he misses CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade

Jayce.name: Jayce
Jayce.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Jayce top, 1,429 games; counterstats all ranks ~52%
Jayce.summary: Jayce pokes you early with Shock Blast. You win the all-in once he misses his poke. Save Leap Strike to get back to him after Thundering Blow knocks you away.
Jayce.runes: Grasp of the Undying with Second Wind
Jayce.buildNotes: Plated Steelcaps, then Trinity Force. Maw of Malmortius if his poke is too much.
Jayce.skillNotes: Take E first. Counter Strike dodges his autos in both forms. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Farm behind minions to block Shock Blast.
He wants short trades. Take them only when his Shock Blast is down.
lvl4_5: After he misses Shock Blast, Leap Strike onto him with Counter Strike active.
If Thundering Blow knocks you back, walk back in or save Leap Strike to re-engage.
post6: Engage after he has used Thundering Blow.
Keep your HP high. Accelerated Shock Blast hurts.
midgame: Split push. He can't duel you.
Ward your flanks.
lategame: Dive him when a teammate has CC on him.
Save Counter Strike for his hammer-form burst.

threats: Shock Blast (Q): poke, much stronger through Acceleration Gate
To the Skies! (hammer Q): gap closer
avoid: Chasing him while Acceleration Gate speed is up

Kayle.name: Kayle
Kayle.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Kayle top, 684 games; counterstats all ranks ~55%
Kayle.summary: You win lane hard early. Kayle is melee until 6 and scales massively later, so punish her before 6, freeze, and deny her farm.
Kayle.runes: Grasp of the Undying, or Press the Attack
Kayle.summoners: Flash + Ignite (Ignite cuts Celestial Blessing's heal)
Kayle.buildNotes: Plated Steelcaps, then Trinity Force. Hullbreaker helps you end before she scales.
Kayle.skillNotes: Take E first. Counter Strike dodges her autos. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: She's melee range until 6. Trade hard every time she walks up to last hit.
Stand in her wave to deny CS.
lvl4_5: Freeze near your tower and zone her off the wave.
Engage when Celestial Blessing is on cooldown, so she can't heal or run.
post6: She becomes ranged at 6. Divine Judgement makes her (or an ally) invulnerable, so hold Counter Strike's stun until it ends.
Keep pushing your advantage and take her tower plates.
midgame: Split push and take towers. She can't match you until later.
Invade her jungle side with your jungler to deny farm.
lategame: She's a hard carry after level 16. Dive her immediately in fights.
Stun her right after Divine Judgement ends.

Rumble.name: Rumble
Rumble.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Rumble top, 358 games; counterstats all ranks ~48%
Rumble.summary: Rumble has strong AoE with Flamespitter in Danger Zone. Engage when he overheats and is silenced. Counter Strike dodges his burning overheated autos.
Rumble.runes: Grasp of the Undying with Second Wind
Rumble.buildNotes: Mercury's Treads. Kaenic Rookern and Wit's End against his damage.
Rumble.skillNotes: Take E first. Counter Strike reduces Flamespitter's AoE damage and dodges his overheated autos. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Stay out of Flamespitter's cone and farm safely.
Trade when his heat is low. He hasn't built up Danger Zone yet.
lvl4_5: When he overheats, he's silenced. Leap Strike onto him with Counter Strike active to dodge his overheated autos.
Electro Harpoon slows you. Don't chase after being hit twice.
post6: The Equalizer zones you with a burning line. Walk out of it immediately.
Engage after he has used R.
midgame: Split push once you have magic resist.
Ward your flanks.
lategame: Dive him when a teammate has CC on him.
Turn on Counter Strike against Flamespitter.

Ryze.name: Ryze
Ryze.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Ryze top, 159 games (small sample)
Ryze.summary: You win early trades, and Ryze scales later. Engage when Rune Prison is on cooldown so he can't root you.
Ryze.buildNotes: Mercury's Treads. Kaenic Rookern and Wit's End against his damage.
Ryze.skillNotes: Take E first. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Trade hard. He's weak early.
Rune Prison roots you. Don't Leap Strike in while it's up.
lvl4_5: Once he uses Rune Prison, Leap Strike on him and all-in.
Deny his last hits by standing in his wave.
post6: Realm Warp lets his team escape or reposition. Watch where he stands.
Keep up the pressure.
midgame: Split push. He can't duel you.
Ward your flanks.
lategame: Dive him when a teammate has CC on him.
Save Counter Strike for his burst.

Smolder.name: Smolder
Smolder.winRateSource: lolalytics top-vs-top sample is only 37 games (56.76%), too small to use; the 51.26% (911 games) default figure is against Smolder bot
Smolder.summary: You win lane early. Counter Strike dodges his autos but not Super Scorcher Breath. Kill him before his stacks scale.
Smolder.runes: Grasp of the Undying, or Press the Attack
Smolder.skillNotes: Take E first. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Trade hard. He's weak early and needs to stack Super Scorcher Breath.
Deny his last hits. Every CS he takes with Q adds stacks.
lvl4_5: Engage when Flap is on cooldown. Flap flies over walls.
Achooo! slows you. Leap Strike through it.
post6: MMOOOMMMM! heals him if he's in the middle of it. Don't fight inside it.
Keep up the pressure.
midgame: Split push and take towers before he scales.
Ward your flanks.
lategame: Dive him when a teammate has CC on him.
Turn on Counter Strike against his autos.

Swain.name: Swain
Swain.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Swain top, 149 games (small sample)
Swain.summary: Swain drains you with Demonic Ascension, and Nevermove roots you on its way back. Dodge the return path and buy anti-heal.
Swain.buildNotes: Mercury's Treads. Chempunk Chainsword for anti-heal. Kaenic Rookern against his damage.
Swain.skillNotes: Take E first. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Nevermove roots you on its return. Step sideways out of its path.
Trade when Nevermove is on cooldown.
lvl4_5: After he misses Nevermove, Leap Strike onto him.
Death's Hand pokes. Don't stand in its cone.
post6: Demonic Ascension drains nearby enemies. Walk out of its range unless you have anti-heal.
Engage after he has used R.
midgame: Split push. With anti-heal he can't duel you.
Ward your flanks.
lategame: Dive him when a teammate has CC on him.
Save Counter Strike for his engage.

avoid: Fighting him during Demonic Ascension without anti-heal

Sylas.name: Sylas
Sylas.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Sylas top, 260 games
Sylas.summary: You win lane. Counter Strike dodges his Petricite Burst autos. Hold it for when Abduct pulls him in. He can steal your Grandmaster-at-Arms with Hijack.
Sylas.buildNotes: Mercury's Treads. Chempunk Chainsword for anti-heal.
Sylas.skillNotes: Take E first. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Trade hard. He's weak early.
Turn on Counter Strike when he empowers his autos with Petricite Burst.
lvl4_5: When Abduct pulls him to you, Counter Strike stuns him as he lands.
Kingslayer heals more when he's low. Ignite before he casts it.
post6: He can steal your R with Hijack.
Engage after he has used Abscond/Abduct.
midgame: Split push. He can't duel you.
Ward your flanks.
lategame: Dive him when a teammate has CC on him.
Turn on Counter Strike against his autos.

Vayne.name: Vayne
Vayne.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Vayne top, 313 games; counterstats all ranks ~50%
Vayne.summary: Even lane. Counter Strike dodges her autos so she can't stack Silver Bolts. Stay away from walls to avoid Condemn.
Vayne.buildNotes: Plated Steelcaps, then Trinity Force. Randuin's Omen or Frozen Heart against her autos.
Vayne.skillNotes: Take E first. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Turn on Counter Strike when she walks in to auto. She can't stack Silver Bolts.
Trade when she's in melee range.
lvl4_5: Engage after she uses Tumble.
Fight in the middle of the lane, away from walls.
post6: Final Hour boosts her damage and makes her invisible on Tumble. Engage after R ends.
Keep your HP high.
midgame: Split push. With armor items she can't duel you.
Ward your flanks.
lategame: Dive her when a teammate has CC on her.
Turn on Counter Strike against her autos.

threats: Silver Bolts (W): true damage every 3rd hit

Varus.name: Varus
Varus.winRateSource: lolalytics Emerald+ 26.19, Jax top vs Varus top, 351 games; counterstats all ranks ~53%
Varus.summary: You win hard. Varus is squishy with no dash. All-in after he fires Piercing Arrow.
Varus.runes: Grasp of the Undying, or Press the Attack
Varus.skillNotes: Take E first. Counter Strike dodges his autos, which stack Blight. Max W, then Q.

lvl1_3: Trade hard. He's weak early.
Deny his last hits.
lvl4_5: After he fires Piercing Arrow, Leap Strike onto him and all-in.
Hail of Arrows applies Grievous Wounds. Kill him fast.
post6: Chain of Corruption roots you. Engage after he has used R.
Keep up the pressure.
